issue.title: #off / #on clock tags and inherited offclock: area defaults
issue.description: Off-clock life needs no tag: an area or project note's `offclock: true`, inherited down the task's root walk and overridable by a child's `offclock: false` or a task's `#on`, decides the clock of every untagged task and Event Task beneath it; `#off` replaces `#offclock` as the one spelling bob writes in Obsidian and reads from Google Calendar; `#offclock`, `#off-clock`, and `#untracked` keep working while `bob gcal sync` and `bob gcal list` warn about them (with a once-a-day Obsidian Notice); past Event Task rows are rewritten to `#off`; and `love.md` turns on the first area default.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/off_on_tags_and_offclock_areas.md requests this work
